planets.name: Kepler-408 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-408 with a 2.47-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-408 b was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-408. Its orbit and size follow Marcy et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
